backend/main.mo: Main ICP actor defining the Quantumoney game backend with player profiles, map markers, AR spot claims, planted coins, chat, Stripe payments, and access control logic in Motoko.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping completed feature IDs (removing animations, fixing nav titles, restoring footer, enforcing dark theme) to their affected frontend files and component dependencies.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted catalogue of frontend source file summaries describing the purpose and key details of each component, page, hook, and utility in the frontend.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Quantumoney React app, loading Leaflet CSS/JS via CDN and mounting the React root.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component setting up TanStack Router with four routes (/, /home, /map, /profile), wrapped in QueryClient, LanguageProvider, and AuthProvider.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with three tabs (Home, Map, Profile) using gold active-state highlighting and TanStack Router links.
frontend/src/components/central-bank/Bur: Displays a table of QMY token burn history entries with date, amount, reason, and percentage removed, plus a summary of total tokens burned relative to total supply.
frontend/src/components/central-bank/Dow: Provides buttons to download tokenomics, vesting schedule, burn history as CSV files, and a QMY explanatory document as a plain text file.
frontend/src/components/central-bank/Exp: Renders an accordion-based transparency and documentation section explaining QMY token nature, economic model, XP system, and lock/unlock mechanics.
frontend/src/components/central-bank/Sup: Renders a pure SVG bar and line chart comparing total supply, locked supply, and circulating supply over time periods, with no external chart library dependency.
frontend/src/components/central-bank/Tok: Displays QMY tokenomics metrics (total, circulating, locked, vesting, burned supply) as stat cards and a proportional stacked supply bar with a color-coded legend.
frontend/src/components/central-bank/Ves: Renders a pure SVG area and line chart visualizing the monthly unlocked vs. locked QMY vesting schedule, with no external chart library dependency.
Renders a styled table displaying a vesting schedule with columns for month, unlock date, amount unlocked/locked, cumulative unlocked, and percentage unlocked.
frontend/src/components/Container.tsx: Reusable layout wrapper component that applies responsive max-width constraints (sm/md/lg/xl/full) and horizontal padding.
frontend/src/components/CookieConsentBan: GDPR cookie consent banner that appears after a 1-second delay, persists consent via a custom hook, and links to the privacy policy.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Simple static footer displaying '© 2026 Quantumoney. Todos os direitos reservados.' and 'By HTgamers' with gold/gray styling.
frontend/src/components/gold-paper/GoldP: Displays an interactive global distribution network visualization with clickable hotspot buttons and a regional breakdown, using data from goldPaperSimData.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed top navigation header with logo, desktop/mobile nav links, language toggle, and login/logout button using auth and language contexts.
frontend/src/components/InstitutionalExp: Wrapper section component that renders a prominent disclaimer banner (in PT/EN) marking content as conceptual and non-operational, then renders its children below.
frontend/src/components/LanguageToggle.t: Small button component that toggles the app language between Portuguese and English using the LanguageContext.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main page layout wrapper that composes Header, Footer, BottomNav, and an optional WelcomeBonusBanner shown on first login.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Reusable login/logout button component that reflects authentication state with appropriate icons and styling via AuthContext.
frontend/src/components/PageShell.tsx: Minimal layout wrapper that adds top padding and full viewport height to page content.
frontend/src/components/presale/PresaleL: Interactive explorer for presale phases that lets users select a phase and view its allocation, price per token, bonus percentage, and minimum purchase details.
frontend/src/components/presale/PresaleU: Visualizes a token unlock schedule as a vertical timeline, showing monthly unlock amounts and cumulative percentage unlocked via progress bars over a vesting period.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARCoinBa: Displays a user's QTM coin balance broken down into available, locked, and bonus coins with icons and descriptive labels.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARMonste: Shows a user's captured AR monsters in a grid with their icons, capture dates, and energy boosts, or an empty state prompt if none are captured.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARPlayer: Displays a player's XP and level stats with a progress bar showing advancement toward the next level, including a loading skeleton state.
frontend/src/components/profile/Canister: Renders a panel listing the five official Quantumoney Internet Computer canister IDs with their names, functions, and links to their ICP endpoints.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileG: A simple wrapper component that applies a glass-morphism card style with a yellow border to its children.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileH: A fixed HUD overlay in the top-right corner that displays key player profile stats (nickname, energy, XP, level, and token balances) in a non-interactive panel.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileP: A profile photo upload component with a circular preview, hover camera icon, upload spinner, and hidden file input triggered by clicking the avatar or button.
Renders three placeholder cards for upcoming features: Captured Monsters, Recent Activity, and Quick Actions, each marked as 'Coming soon'.
frontend/src/components/profile/SendRece: Provides send and receive panels for ICP and QMY tokens, including principal ID copying, input validation, and a confirmation dialog before executing transfers.
frontend/src/components/profile/Technica: Displays a technical validation panel showing the authenticated user's Principal ID, all Carteira A canister IDs, a verification timestamp, and sync status.
frontend/src/components/profile/useProfi: A custom hook that derives authentication, registration, and profile-setup visibility state from the user's identity and profile data.
frontend/src/components/profile/WelcomeB: Shows a welcome bonus card with unlocked/locked QMY token counts, XP, a vesting progress bar, and the monthly vesting schedule details.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal form for setting a user nickname and optional photo, which saves the profile via the backend actor and claims a one-time welcome bonus (QMY + XP) displayed on success.
frontend/src/components/ReadOnlyBanner.t: Informational banner component indicating that the current view is read-only and transfer/swap functionality is disabled.
frontend/src/components/SectionNavigator: Full-screen overlay navigation menu listing all app sections with availability badges, allowing users to jump to any route.
frontend/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx: Badge component that displays one of three status states (draft, planned, coming-soon) with a matching icon and color style.
frontend/src/components/Typography.tsx: Exports reusable typed typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, SubsectionTitle, BodyText) with consistent serif font and color styling.
frontend/src/components/wallet/QMYTransa: React component that displays a QMY token transaction history list with loading, error, unsupported, empty, and populated states, rendering each transaction with an appropriate icon and badge.
frontend/src/components/wallet/SendQMYSi: A form card component that simulates sending QMY tokens by accepting a destination principal and amount, calling a simulated send function and showing toast notifications for success or failure.
frontend/src/components/wallet/VestingBr: Displays a vesting breakdown card showing available vs. locked QMY balances, a progress bar, and a live countdown timer to the next token unlock event.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeBonusBann: Full-screen overlay modal that displays the QMY and XP amounts awarded as a first-login welcome bonus with a dismiss button.
frontend/src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx: Provides authentication context using Internet Identity, exposing login/logout, principal ID, initialization state, and welcome bonus state to the app via a React context and custom hook.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: Provides a bilingual (Portuguese/English) i18n context with a translation function, persisting the selected language to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, invalidating and refetching dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useARGameData.ts: React Query hook that fetches the authenticated user's player profile from the ICP logic canister using a dynamically defined IDL factory and the user's Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useCookieConsent.ts: Custom hook that manages cookie consent state by reading and writing a boolean flag to localStorage, exposing give and revoke consent functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useDao.ts: Provides React Query hooks for DAO proposal management (list, get, create, vote, revoke) using an in-memory store as a temporary substitute for a Governance canister backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useICPLedger.ts: React Query hook that fetches the ICP token balance for a given principal using the ICPLedgerClient singleton.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state tracking via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useLuxuryBank.ts: React Query hook that aggregates token supply, vesting categories, time series, and player metrics from the backend actor to produce a LuxuryBankData summary.
frontend/src/hooks/useMapMarkers.ts: React Query hook that fetches map markers from the backend actor, refreshing every 30 seconds.
frontend/src/hooks/useProfile.ts: Provides hooks for fetching, saving, and updating the current user's PlayerProfile via the backend actor using React Query.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublicChat.ts: Re-exports backend-connected chat query hooks and wraps them in a usePublicChat convenience hook exposing messages, send, and loading state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYLedger.ts: React Query hook that fetches the QMY (ICRC) token balance for a given principal using the ICRCLedgerClient singleton.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYTransactions.ts: React Query hook stub for fetching QMY transaction history; currently returns null as the ledger canister does not expose transaction history.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYVesting.ts: React Query hook for fetching QMY vesting info; returns null because vesting data is not yet available on-chain.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Central collection of React Query hooks for interacting with the backend actor, covering user profile, map markers, and public chat operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useSharedLocation.ts: React hook that watches the device's geolocation via the browser API and returns the current coordinates, loading state, and any error.
frontend/src/hooks/useSimulatedQMYVestin: React hook that simulates QMY token vesting using localStorage to persist a start date, allowing toggling of the simulation and computing available/locked token amounts.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Cinzel/Rajdhani fonts, sets up Tailwind, defines dark-themed CSS variables, and styles Leaflet map components and custom scrollbars.
Utility functions for financial calculations including percentage change, currency formatting, large number abbreviation, and SVG sparkline path generation.
frontend/src/lib/capacitor-plugins.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for Capacitor native plugin integrations.
frontend/src/lib/dao/preProposalsData.ts: Defines the PreProposal interface and exports a static array of sample DAO governance proposals covering treasury, distribution, tokenomics, and development categories.
frontend/src/lib/deep-links.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for deep-link handling logic.
frontend/src/lib/icp/account.ts: Derives ICP account identifiers from principals using a simplified (non-cryptographically-secure) SHA-224 hash with CRC32 checksum, following the ICP ledger specification.
frontend/src/lib/icp/ledgerClient.ts: Singleton client that connects to the ICP ledger canister via @dfinity/agent and exposes a method to query ICP account balances by principal ID.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/icrc.idl.ts: Defines the Candid IDL factory for an ICRC-1 token canister, exposing balance, decimals, name, symbol, and total supply query methods.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/ledgerClient.ts: Singleton client for the QMY ICRC-1 ledger canister that queries token balances for a given principal using the ICRC-1 standard interface.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/transactions.ts: Attempts to query ICRC-1 transaction history for an account, returning parsed transfer/mint/burn transactions or null if the method is unsupported.
frontend/src/lib/map/mapDatasets.ts: Exports static arrays of geographic map markers for coins and monsters at real-world landmarks, plus a default map center coordinate.
frontend/src/lib/map/simulatedMapProject: Provides a simple equirectangular projection function that converts lat/lon coordinates to 2D screen x/y positions given a center, zoom, and viewport size.
frontend/src/lib/offline-manager.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for offline/PWA caching management logic.
Defines the CentralBankData interface and returns hardcoded simulated data for QMY token supply, categories, usage stats, presale progress, and geographic distribution.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/goldPaperSimData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and a data function for simulated Gold Paper distribution, including hotspot locations (landmarks worldwide) and regional allocation breakdowns totaling 600 million tokens.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/presaleSimData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and a data function for simulated presale phases (Seed, Private, Public), including allocation amounts, token prices, bonuses, and statuses for a 90 million token presale.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/simulatedSend.ts: Provides a simulated token send function that validates a destination ICP Principal, checks balance, and returns a success or error result with a 90% random success rate after a 1.5s delay.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/simulatedVesting.ts: Calculates vesting schedule based on a start date, unlocking 100 tokens initially and 100 more every 30 days from a 900-token locked pool, returning available balance and next unlock info.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that renders the root component wrapped with React Query's QueryClientProvider and a custom InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: An about page for the Quantumoney project describing its unified ICP-based ecosystem, including the QMY token, integrated AR game, single Internet Identity, and draft status disclaimer.
frontend/src/pages/ARDistributionPage.ts: A static informational page describing a conceptual AR token distribution model, prominently noting it is educational only with no active distribution, and citing MiCA/GDPR compliance.

frontend/src/pages/ARMode.tsx: A placeholder page for the AR Mode feature, displaying a camera icon and a 'coming soon' message inside a styled card layout.
frontend/src/pages/BancoCentral.tsx: A 'Central Bank' dashboard page displaying QMY tokenomics stats, vesting schedules, and economic data using stat cards, tables, and accordions, with data sourced from a custom luxury bank hook.
frontend/src/pages/Colecao.tsx: Displays a monster collection page showing 20 crypto-themed monsters with rarity tiers, tracking which ones the authenticated user has captured and summarizing total energy bonuses.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders a bilingual (PT/EN) contact and support page showing helpdesk email and website URL for Quantumoney.
frontend/src/pages/DAOCreateProposalPage: Placeholder page for DAO proposal creation, displaying a 'coming soon' message and a link back to the map.

frontend/src/pages/GoldPaper.tsx: Renders the Quantumoney (QMY) Gold Paper page, a conceptual/educational institutional document covering vision, tokenomics, ecosystem, roadmap, governance, technical architecture, and legal compliance sections with draft status badges.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Authenticated home page displaying two navigation cards linking to the Map and Profile pages, using localized text and gold-themed styling.

frontend/src/pages/MapMode.tsx: Empty file with no content or exports.
